prompt: Ecto Repo init/2 callback :ignore return restriction
answer:
`Ecto.Repo.init/2` may return `:ignore` **only when called with the `:supervisor` context**.

When called with `:runtime`—for example, while reading configuration without starting a process—it must return:

```elixir
{:ok, updated_config}
```

The callback specification is:

```elixir
@callback init(:supervisor | :runtime, Keyword.t()) ::
  {:ok, Keyword.t()} | :ignore
```

The Ecto documentation explicitly states that `:ignore` is permitted only in the `:supervisor` case. ([Ecto.Repo docs](https://ecto.hexdocs.pm/Ecto.Repo.html))
